title.hr: Dijeljenje s ostatkom: krug po krug
title.en: Division with a remainder: round by round

concept.hr: Što ostane kad za svakoga više nema: ostatak, uvijek manji od djelitelja
concept.en: What is left when there is not one for everyone: less than the divisor

summary.hr: Dijeli bombone djeci krug po krug, mijenjaj koliko ih je i na koliko djece, provjeri s q · d + r i nađi prevelik ostatak.
summary.en: Deal sweets to children round by round, change how many and among how many, check with q · d + r and spot a remainder too big.

concept.hr: Jednakost vrijedi, ali 7 bombona dovoljno je za još jedan krug
concept.en: The equality holds, but 7 sweets are enough for one more round
